title: Sunday · the doughnut
logline: The Legacy's doughnut spare, close, in watercolor: the narrow tread, the yellow rim, the dust. A month before it carries him four hundred miles. The strip's one Sunday about a tire.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the front left of a faded green wagon on gravel: the doughnut spare, narrow, its yellow rim, the mismatch with the other wheel visible.

image.prompt: the front of a faded green station wagon on gravel with a narrow temporary spare tire on a yellow rim mismatched against the full-size wheel behind, no words
image.notes: The doughnut (dw_2013-10-14). Four hundred miles on it in July.

panels.name: Tire

panels.composition: Tier 2: the tread, close. Thin. A pebble in it.

image.prompt: close on a temporary spare tire's thin tread with a pebble caught in it, no words

panels.name: Tread

panels.composition: Tier 3: 101 north from the driver's seat, the road going on. Held.

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: A Sunday about a tire. The road north.
